blocks.text: Is chapter ne chaar ubharti technologies, un se mutasir log aur aqdar, Pakistan ki khidmat mein un ka istemal, aur unhein zimmedar rakhne wale qawaid dekhe. Table is ki bunyadi istilahat ikatthi karti hai.

blocks.caption: Chapter 8 ki kaleedi istilahat
rows: Ubharti technologies
Nayi ya tezi se barhti technologies jo logon ke rehne, kaam, rabte aur masail hal karne ka tareeqa badal sakti hain
Artificial intelligence
Insani zehanat wale kaam karti machines: seekhna, istidlal, tasveer pehchanna, awaz samajhna, faisla
Internet of Things
Internet se jure tabai devices jo data jama, share aur amal karein, maslan smart watches, lights, cameras, soil sensors
Cloud computing
Data rakhne, applications chalane aur computing wasail ke liye Internet par mabni khidmat
Blockchain
Jure blocks mein record-keeping, mehfooz, shaffaf, na-qabil-e-tabdeel lain-dain
Stakeholders
Technology se mutasir afraad ya groups: users, developers, idare, hukoomatein, muashra
Akhlaqi AI / AI mein bias
Munsif, shaffaf, jawabdeh, mehfooz aur zimmedar AI / janibdar data, kharab design ya na-barabar numaindagi se na-insafi
Shamooliyat
Technology jo har jins, saqafat, zaban, ilaqe aur pas-e-manzar ke logon ki munsifana khidmat kare
Mafadat ka takrao
Jab aik stakeholder ke maqasid doosron ke huqooq, hifazat ya mafad ko nuqsan dein
AI governance
AI zimmedari se banane aur use karne ke qawaid, policies aur usool
Zimmedarana jiddat
Technology jo akhlaqiyat, hifazat, saqafat, insaf aur taveel asar dekhte hue haqeeqi masail hal kare
Smart zara'at / technologies ka milap
Kheti behtar karne ke liye IoT, AI, cloud aur blockchain / technologies mila kar aik zyada mufeed hal
Policy aur qanooni dhaanche
Logon aur muashre ki hifazat ke liye technologies ki tameer, istemal aur control ke qawaid aur qawaneen

items: AI, IoT, cloud computing aur blockchain: har aik ka kaam aur milap.
Stakeholders, saqafat, akhlaqi usool aur bias.
Pakistan ke liye applications, hukmrani aur zimmedarana jiddat.
